name: sdd-spec-factory
description: Spec-driven development factory that converts a client request or feature idea into detailed specs (product, module, page, component, validation, database, API, UI) and an executable task with PR and QA/review checklists.

interface.shortDescription: Turn requests into detailed specs and executable tasks.
interface.longDescription: SDD Spec Factory gives Codex a repeatable spec-driven workflow: diagnose a client request or feature, consolidate scope, generate layered specs (product, module, page, component, validation, database, API, UI) separating Banco, API/Backend, Frontend/UI, tests, security, observability, pending decisions, risks and acceptance criteria, then produce a small executable task linked to specs, issue, branch and PR, followed by code review and QA checklists.
defaultPrompt: Use SDD Spec Factory to turn this client request into specs and an executable task.
Use SDD Spec Factory to write the page and component specs for this feature.
Use SDD Spec Factory to create the task, PR checklist and QA checklist for this work.
Use SDD Spec Factory to run Phase 0 diagnosis and list the critical questions before specs.
